name: All Our Ideas
tagline: A platform for crowdsourcing ideas and priorities through pairwise comparison voting
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
academic_citations: Noveck, B. S. (2015). Smart Citizens: Participatory Governance in the Digital Age. Harvard University Press.
Landemore, H. (2020). Open Democracy: Reinventing Popular Rule for the Twenty-First Century. Princeton University Press.
curation_criteria: Ideas submitted by users are ranked through pairwise comparison voting
political_relevance_summary: Addresses barriers to meaningful citizen participation in democratic decision-making by providing tools for public engagement and deliberation.

movement_building_utility.notes: Platform enabling direct democratic participation or civic engagement.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (multiple countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability.
primary_users_or_beneficiaries: citizens seeking to participate in local democratic processes
